# Descriptives

## Social Subjective Status (SSS)

```{r}
#| label: fig-ess-dist
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of subjective social status (own, family of origin and children) by wave"
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-align: center

ess_labs <- c(ess = "Own", ess_og = "Family of origin", ess_hijos = "Children")

df_ess <- df_study1 %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(ola, all_of(names(ess_labs))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-ola, names_to = "var", values_to = "val") %>%
  filter(!is.na(val)) %>%
  mutate(var = factor(var, levels = names(ess_labs), labels = ess_labs)) %>%
  count(var, ola, val) %>%
  group_by(var, ola) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

df_ess_mean <- df_study1 %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(ola, all_of(names(ess_labs))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-ola, names_to = "var", values_to = "val") %>%
  mutate(var = factor(var, levels = names(ess_labs), labels = ess_labs)) %>%
  group_by(var, ola) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(val, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(df_ess, aes(x = val, y = prop)) +
  geom_col(fill = met.brewer("Hiroshige", 1, direction = -1)[1], width = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(data = df_ess_mean, aes(xintercept = m),
             linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey20") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:10) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), n.breaks = 3) +
  facet_grid(ola ~ var) +
  labs(x = "Subjective social status (0 = lowest, 10 = highest)", y = NULL,
       caption = "Dashed line: wave mean.") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

## Social Subjective Mobility

```{r}
#| label: mov-dist-setup
#| include: false

mov_labs <- c(
  mov_dir      = "Own - origin",
  mov_og       = "Own - mean origin",
  mov_exp      = "Children - own",
  mov_inter    = "Intergenerational (children - own - origin)",
  mov_exp_og   = "Children - origin",
  ess_traj     = "Trajectory slope",
  ess_traj_sqt = "Trajectory curve"
)

df_mov <- df_study1 %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(ola, all_of(names(mov_labs))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-ola, names_to = "var", values_to = "val") %>%
  filter(!is.na(val)) %>%
  mutate(val = as.numeric(val))

plot_mov <- function(v) {
  d <- filter(df_mov, var == v)
  ggplot(d, aes(x = val)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, boundary = 0, fill = met.brewer("Hiroshige", 1, direction = -1)[1],
                   colour = "white") +
    geom_vline(data = d %>% group_by(ola) %>% summarise(m = mean(val), .groups = "drop"),
               aes(xintercept = m), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey20") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50") +
    facet_wrap(~ ola, nrow = 1) +
    labs(title = mov_labs[[v]], x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}
```

# Correlation matrix


```{r}
#| label: tbl-correlations
#| tbl-cap: "Average within-wave Spearman correlations between subjective social status and MJP"
#| tbl-cap-location: top
#| include: false

vars <- c(
  ess          = "Subjective social status",
  ess_og       = "Family subjective social status",
  ess_hijos    = "Son's subjective social status",
  mjp_index    = "MJP index",
  sex          = "Sex (Female)",
  age          = "Age",
  ideo        = "Political ideology"
)

df_cor <- df_study1 %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(ola, all_of(names(vars))) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("just_"), ~ as.numeric(.x)),
         across(-ola, ~ as.numeric(.x)))

# one correlation matrix per wave
cor_waves <- df_cor %>%
  group_split(ola, .keep = FALSE) %>%
  map(~ cor(.x, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))

# average across waves on Fisher's z scale
z_mean <- Reduce(`+`, map(cor_waves, ~ atanh(pmin(pmax(.x, -0.999999), 0.999999)))) / length(cor_waves)
cor_avg <- tanh(z_mean)
diag(cor_avg) <- 1

# full matrix (with variable labels) kept for the corrplot below
cor_full <- cor_avg
rownames(cor_full) <- colnames(cor_full) <- unname(vars)

rownames(cor_avg) <- paste0(seq_along(vars), ". ", vars)
colnames(cor_avg) <- seq_along(vars)
cor_avg[upper.tri(cor_avg)] <- NA

cor_avg %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  kbl(digits = 2, format = table_format, booktabs = TRUE,
      caption = NULL) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) %>%
  footnote(general = paste0("Spearman correlations computed within each wave (",
                            length(cor_waves), " waves, 2016-2023) and averaged using Fisher's z."),
           general_title = "Note:", footnote_as_chunk = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-correlations
#| fig-cap: "Average within-wave Spearman correlations (corrplot)"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-align: center
#| include: false

corrplot(cor_full,
         method = "color",
         type = "lower",
         diag = FALSE,
         order = "original",
         addCoef.col = "black",
         number.cex = 0.75,
         number.digits = 2,
         tl.col = "black",
         tl.cex = 0.85,
         tl.srt = 45,
         cl.cex = 0.8,
         col = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(200),
         col.lim = c(-1, 1),
         is.corr = TRUE,
         mar = c(0, 0, 1, 0))
```


```{r}
#| label: fun-corrplot-wave
#| include: false

plot_cor_wave <- function(i) {
  m <- cor_waves[[i]]
  rownames(m) <- colnames(m) <- unname(vars)
  corrplot(m,
           method = "color",
           type = "lower",
           diag = FALSE,
           order = "original",
           addCoef.col = "black",
           number.cex = 0.75,
           number.digits = 2,
           tl.col = "black",
           tl.cex = 0.85,
           tl.srt = 45,
           cl.cex = 0.8,
           col = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(200),
           col.lim = c(-1, 1),
           is.corr = TRUE,
           na.label = "-",
           mar = c(0, 0, 1, 0))
}
```

# Modelling

## Social Subjective Status (SSS)

```{r}
#| label: draft-modelos

## WE and BE main effects - MJP index
# mjp_index is a continuous mean index (1-5), so linear mixed models (lmer)
# are used instead of cumulative link models (clmm). REML = FALSE so that
# models with different fixed effects are comparable (LRT, BIC).

df_model <- df_model %>% group_by(idencuesta) %>% 
  mutate(age_gm=mean(age,na.rm = FALSE)) %>% 
  mutate(inc_eq_mill_gm=mean(inc_eq_mill,na.rm = FALSE))

model1 <- lmer(mjp_index ~ 1 +
             ola_num +
             ola_2 +
             ess_cwc +
             ess_mean + 
             (1 + ola_num | idencuesta),
           REML = FALSE,
           data = df_model)

model2 <- lmer(mjp_index ~ 1 +
             ola_num +
             ola_2 +
             ess_og_cwc +
             ess_og_mean + 
             (1 + ola_num | idencuesta),
           REML = FALSE,
           data = df_model)

model3 <- lmer(mjp_index ~ 1 +
             ola_num +
             ola_2 +
             ess_hijos_cwc +
             ess_hijos_mean + 
             (1 + ola_num | idencuesta),
           REML = FALSE,
           data = df_model)

model4 <- lmer(mjp_index ~ 1 +
             ola_num +
             ola_2 +
             ideo +
             sex +
             age +
             ess_cwc +
             ess_mean + 
             (1 + ola_num | idencuesta),
           REML = FALSE,
           data = df_model)

model5 <- lmer(mjp_index ~ 1 +
             ola_num +
             ola_2 +
             ideo +
             sex +
             age +
             ess_og_cwc +
             ess_og_mean + 
             (1 + ola_num | idencuesta),
           REML = FALSE,
           data = df_model)

model6 <- lmer(mjp_index ~ 1 +
             ola_num +
             ola_2 +
             ideo +
             sex +
             age +
             ess_hijos_cwc +
             ess_hijos_mean +
             (1 + ola_num | idencuesta),
           REML = FALSE,
           data = df_model)

model7 <- lmer(mjp_index ~ 1 +
             ola_num +
             ola_2 +
             ideo +
             sex +
             age +
             ess_cwc +
             ess_mean +
             ess_og_cwc +
             ess_og_mean +
             ess_hijos_cwc +
             ess_hijos_mean +
             (1 + ola_num | idencuesta),
           REML = FALSE,
           data = df_model)

```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-draft-modelos
#| tbl-cap: "Draft linear longitudinal multilevel models for the MJP index"
#| tbl-cap-location: top
#| results: asis

draft_coef <- list(
  "(Intercept)" = "Intercept",
  ola_num = "Wave",
  ola_2 = "Wave^2",
  ess_cwc = "SSS own (WE)",
  ess_mean = "SSS own (BE)",
  ess_og_cwc = "SSS origin (WE)",
  ess_og_mean = "SSS origin (BE)",
  ess_hijos_cwc = "SSS children (WE)",
  ess_hijos_mean = "SSS children (BE)",
  sexFemale = "Sex: Female (ref. Male)",
  age = "Age",
  ideoCenter = "Political ideology: Center (ref. Left)",
  ideoRight = "Political ideology: Right (ref. Left)",
  `ideoDoes not identify` = "Political ideology: Does not identify (ref. Left)"
)

draft_models <- list(model1, model2, model3, model4, model5, model6, model7)

htmlreg(draft_models,
        custom.model.names = paste0("Model ", seq_along(draft_models)),
        caption.above = T,
        caption = NULL,
        stars = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001),
        custom.coef.map = draft_coef,
        digits = 3,
        leading.zero = T,
        include.loglik = FALSE,
        include.aic = FALSE,
        center = T,
        custom.note = "Note: SSS = subjective social status; WE = within-person effect; BE = between-person effect. Cells contain regression coefficients with standard errors in parentheses. %stars.")
```


## Social Subjective Mobility

```{r}
#| label: draft-modelos-ssm

## WE and BE main effects of each subjective mobility measure - MJP index
# Same specification as the SSS models above (lmer, REML = FALSE, random
# intercept and wave slope by respondent). The mobility measures are
# differences/combinations of ess, ess_og and ess_hijos, so they are entered
# one at a time (they are collinear if combined), except the trajectory
# slope and curve, which are entered together.

mov_vars <- c("mov_dir", "mov_og", "mov_exp", "mov_inter", "mov_exp_og")

fit_mov <- function(terms, controls = FALSE) {
  rhs <- c("ola_num", "ola_2",
           if (controls) c("ideo", "sex", "age"),
           terms,
           "(1 + ola_num | idencuesta)")
  lmer(reformulate(rhs, response = "mjp_index"), REML = FALSE, data = df_model)
}

mov_terms <- c(
  lapply(mov_vars, function(v) paste0(v, c("_cwc", "_mean"))),
  list(c("ess_traj_cwc", "ess_traj_mean"),
       c("ess_traj_cwc", "ess_traj_mean", "ess_traj_sqt_cwc", "ess_traj_sqt_mean"))
)

# models 8-14: mobility only; models 15-21: with controls
mov_models   <- lapply(mov_terms, fit_mov)
mov_models_c <- lapply(mov_terms, fit_mov, controls = TRUE)

# model 22: all mobility measures together (with controls). They are linear
# combinations of ess, ess_og and ess_hijos, so the design is rank deficient and
# lmer drops the aliased terms (kept in the order they are entered).
mov_models_c[[length(mov_models_c) + 1]] <-
  fit_mov(unique(unlist(mov_terms)), controls = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-draft-modelos-ssm
#| tbl-cap: "Linear longitudinal multilevel models for the MJP index: subjective social mobility"
#| tbl-cap-location: top
#| results: asis

mov_coef <- list(
  "(Intercept)" = "Intercept",
  ola_num = "Wave",
  ola_2 = "Wave^2",
  sss_index_cwc = "SSS index (WE)",
  sss_index_mean = "SSS index (BE)",
  mov_dir_cwc = "Mobility own - origin (WE)",
  mov_dir_mean = "Mobility own - origin (BE)",
  mov_og_cwc = "Mobility own - mean origin (WE)",
  mov_og_mean = "Mobility own - mean origin (BE)",
  mov_exp_cwc = "Expected mobility children - own (WE)",
  mov_exp_mean = "Expected mobility children - own (BE)",
  mov_inter_cwc = "Intergenerational mobility (WE)",
  mov_inter_mean = "Intergenerational mobility (BE)",
  mov_exp_og_cwc = "Expected mobility children - origin (WE)",
  mov_exp_og_mean = "Expected mobility children - origin (BE)",
  ess_traj_cwc = "SSS trajectory slope (WE)",
  ess_traj_mean = "SSS trajectory slope (BE)",
  ess_traj_sqt_cwc = "SSS trajectory curve (WE)",
  ess_traj_sqt_mean = "SSS trajectory curve (BE)",
  sexFemale = "Sex: Female (ref. Male)",
  age = "Age",
  ideoCenter = "Political ideology: Center (ref. Left)",
  ideoRight = "Political ideology: Right (ref. Left)",
  `ideoDoes not identify` = "Political ideology: Does not identify (ref. Left)"
)

mov_note <- "Note: Model 22 includes all mobility measures; since they are linear combinations of the three SSS measures, aliased terms are dropped by lmer (empty cells). WE = within-person effect; BE = between-person effect. Cells contain regression coefficients with standard errors in parentheses. %stars."

htmlreg(mov_models,
        custom.model.names = paste0("Model ", 8:14),
        caption.above = T,
        caption = NULL,
        stars = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001),
        custom.coef.map = mov_coef,
        digits = 3,
        leading.zero = T,
        include.loglik = FALSE,
        include.aic = FALSE,
        center = T,
        custom.note = mov_note)
```
